envelope.description: Implement resumable cleanup claims for both families

body.title: Implement resumable cleanup claims for both families
body.summary: Extend existing design private-claim pattern to exact multi-file cleanup; preserve closed audit/permanent proof, sync claim before destructive deletes, delete claim last.
acceptanceChecks: Crash after each deletion resumes cleanup-only without Git/model calls; missing runtime without claim stays fenced; current approval and file identities rechecked; unrelated files retained.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.

tests.name: Extend both-family cleanup tests: fault every claim/rename/unlink/fsync boundary; cleanup retry after runtime/checkpoint removal, approval/file mismatch and arbitrary missing-runtime refusal.
